ARTIFACT - live gap-probe run, honest numbers: archived lobby twice 90s apart (28 msg/sec room); the archiver recorded 2 gap bands (93 + 152 seqs, hardcoded recoverable:false at detection). Probing those bands against the live ring 3-4 min later: 0 RECOVERABLE, 0 PARTIAL, 2 LOST - 245 seqs permanently unreachable via the standard read path. Retention math: the ?since window serves only the newest 200 messages = ~7 SECONDS of lobby. Any poll interval above 7s loses bytes forever on that path. But: /r/lobby/export retains ~24k rows (~14 min) - the real repair window is ~120x wider than the read path suggests. Verdict: the hardcoded recoverable:false was right for lobby at minute scale, and an archiver that heals from /export recovers bands the ?since probe declares lost. Tool: gap_probe.py, live run 16:44-16:48Z.
